title: China-to-Albania EV Charger Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Albania follows an EU-aligned EV architecture direction, and installers should align charging interfaces with IEC 62196 Type 2 for AC and IEC 62196-3 CCS2 for DC-fast charging unless a project specification states otherwise. This is the practical compatibility target for Albania-facing EV charging projects.
target_standards: IEC 62196-2 for Type 2 AC conductive couplers
IEC 61851-1 for EV conductive charging requirements
IEC 61851-23 for DC EV supply equipment
rows.china_equivalent: China uses GB/T 20234-2 AC connectors and GB/T 20234-3 DC connectors in domestic charging products. Those are not interchangeable with IEC 62196 Type 2 and CCS2 form factors without hardware and protocol redesign.
rows.gap: A GB/T-only interface should not be treated as project-ready for Albania. Validate connector family, locking direction, control-proxy functions, and DC communication expectations before shipment against Albania-facing vehicle fleet and utility deployment assumptions.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for projects where Type 2 / CCS2 compatibility is required by installer, fleet, or vehicle mix
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T connector evidence is not sufficient when IEC Type 2 / CCS2 is required

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Plan connector hardware and protocol changes before order confirmation. GB/T-only designs should not be treated as Albania-ready without explicit Type 2 / CCS2 readiness evidence.

rows.requirement: Grid Coordination, 230/400 V 50 Hz, and Site Approval
rows.target_requirement: Albania uses 230/400 V 50 Hz systems for low-voltage connections, while site interconnection documents are typically handled through ERE and OST at the project level. EV charger interconnection should therefore include single-line diagrams, load studies, harmonics and flicker checks, protection settings, metering strategy, and commissioning evidence for the local supply point.
target_standards: ERE site interconnection and operating documents used by ERE and OST
IEC 61000 power-quality and interoperability test context
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic projects commonly reference 220/380 V operation, GB/T 18487-2023 test and acceptance records, and local distribution-company requirements. Those references are useful for technical preparation but do not resolve Albanian site coordination and project gating.
rows.gap: Do not use China domestic acceptance records as Albania grid access evidence. Confirm Albanian voltage/frequency settings, single-line interface assumptions, harmonic limits, protective device coordination, and commissioning route before energization.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where Albania project operators or utilities require local site-level interconnection and commissioning documents
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese domestic grid records can assist technical preparation but are not acceptance substitutes

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Albanian interconnection remains a site-level project gate. Verify 230/400 V 50 Hz compatibility and local utility conditions before shipment and before system energisation.

rows.requirement: Albania EV Charger Market Access and Conformity Placement
rows.target_requirement: Market placement for EV charging equipment in Albania should map each SKU to the relevant market-authority checks, customs route, and market role. Confirm whether the equipment falls under import conformity routing, project-based utility review, and service-operator requirements with ERE, OST, and customs partners.
target_standards: Albania customs and market-entry requirements for power-electronics import
Albania power charging infrastructure access and market approval framework
Albania power and utilities operational requirements
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese market channels commonly prepare customs declaration and CCC or GB-related dossiers for domestic distribution. These are useful internal references but do not replace Albania-specific import customs routes and EV charger market checks.
china_standards: CCC and domestic product compliance records where in scope
rows.gap: Build Albania-facing route documentation first, including importer registration, customs code mapping, project safety classification, and utility interconnection obligations before sales and operation claims. A national conformity certificate from another market is insufficient.

mandatory_status.target: Conditional to mandatory based on model type and whether market entry is via public deployment, fleet deployment, or private installation
mandatory_status.cn: China domestic market dossiers are preparatory only, not Albania market acceptance

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Confirm import-market route and project-level requirements before claiming Albania readiness. Do not infer market access from China charger packaging or test reports alone.

rows.requirement: OCPP Interoperability and Site EMC / Power-Quality Evidence
rows.target_requirement: Albania projects commonly implement networked charging through project-level back-office and utility coordination. OCPP readiness, remote monitoring, fault reporting, and load-management behavior should match the project contract, while EMC and power-quality evidence should align with IEC 61000 expectations for the local 50 Hz 230/400 V profile.
target_standards: Project-specific OCPP version and cybersecurity requirements
IEC 61000 series for EMC and power quality
Albanian utility coordination for connected chargers
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic networked charging often uses GB/T 27930 in the charger-to-vehicle control path and domestic telemetry stacks. These materials support technical design comparison, but OCPP interoperability and Albanian site-level EMC evidence usually need separate confirmation.
rows.gap: Confirm required OCPP profile and security model at project stage, and produce interoperability test logs, remote-control traces, EMC and harmonic reports, and utility interface evidence before public operation.

mandatory_status.target: Project-dependent; mandatory for networked public chargers and fleet charging sites requiring remote operations
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T telemetry evidence does not replace Albania project OCPP or utility coordination requirements

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For Albania-facing public charging, align OCPP scope with the project operator and produce site-level EMC and power-quality evidence before claiming operational readiness.

source.publisher: Open Charge Alliance and Energy Regulatory Entity (ERE), Albania

rows.requirement: Safety Conformity Basis for EV Chargers under IEC 61851
rows.target_requirement: For Albania-facing EV chargers, IEC 61851-1 is commonly used as the electrical safety baseline, while IEC 61851-23 is used for DC EV supply equipment. Project-specific safety documentation should also include enclosure rating, emergency-stop and interlock functions, protective earth integrity, thermal and electrical clearances, and site installation instructions.
rows.china_equivalent: China’s domestic charger safety baseline often references GB/T 18487.1 and GB/T 20234 families. This supports engineering comparison but is not a direct replacement for Albania-facing IEC evidence in project and utility review.
rows.gap: Prepare Albania-facing safety documentation at model level with IEC test reports for protective earth, insulation resistance, locking and interlock verification, emergency disconnect behavior, enclosure IP rating evidence, and user documentation language scope.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for chargers subject to Albania project acceptance and any public or semi-public operation route requiring safety conformance
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese GB/T safety material is project-comparison input and not sufficient for Albania readiness on its own

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not treat China GB/T safety records as final Albania proof. Build an Albania-facing safety file using IEC 61851 evidence and project-accepted installation route docs.

source.publisher: International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC); Energy Regulatory Entity (ERE), Albania
